$comment: The DOI rule's cases, read by both of its tests -- tests/citations_test.ts for lib/citations.ts's isDoi and tests/pipeline/test_doi_references.py for pipeline/export/text.py's is_doi -- so the two predicates cannot drift apart. A DOI is 10., a registrant code of four to nine ASCII digits, a slash and a suffix with no whitespace, around any surrounding whitespace.
